text: Harness: per-role model registry (planner, executor, verifier) across providers
description: Today a loop definition has one provider/model/baseUrl (nvidia, openrouter, openai-compatible). Extend LoopDefinition (shared/src/loop-state.ts) to a map role -> {provider, model, baseUrl, keyName}: planner (decompose), executor, verifier, reflector. Add an Anthropic provider (@ai-sdk/anthropic) next to openai-compatible, so a cheap open model can plan and a different family can verify. Keys stay in the existing secrets file. Backward compatible: a single model fills all roles.

status.comment: LoopDefinition.roles (shared/src/loop-state.ts): planner/executor/verifier/reflector -> {provider, model, baseUrl?}; providers nvidia, openrouter, openai-compatible and now anthropic (@ai-sdk/anthropic), default endpoints filled in. Unset roles use the loop's model (backward compatible; existing loops.json parse with roles: {}). Keys from .bowman/secrets.json incl. new ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (backend secrets schema keeps it). packages/loop-worker/src/models.ts resolves all role models before a cycle and fails naming the role and missing key; stages map decompose->planner, execute->executor, verify->verifier, reflect->reflector; logs and provider error hints name the role's model. Worker start logs the verifier model, or a note when it equals the executor's. Configured by editing loops.json (no UI form, per config-in-files). Evidence: models.test.ts (role fallback, default endpoints, missing-key error), loop-worker 18/18, backend loop-cycle e2e 3/3, typecheck of loop-worker/backend/shared, knip clean.
